name: Market north back-of-house band behind the back-wall cases (staff only): a 360x40 pt strip between the building's north wall (boundary y=159.3, x=656.3..1196.2) and the Market wall-case run drawn at y=200..214 ([643,200,697,214] and the long case [710,202,967,212]), closed on the east by the angled Seafood counter that runs from the wall at (1009,159) to its apex (1024,186) and down to (977,213). Nothing is drawn inside it — no fixture, no badge, no product label — and its only two openings are staff ones: the double swing door drawn between the two cases at x=697..710 (leaf + arc at (699,200)-(700,211)) and the 11 pt pass-through at x=966..977 behind the Seafood counter's west end. It shipped as an isolated 3624-cell component (orange on walkable_overlay.png) because the SEAFOOD seal disk's 20 pt bridge closed that pass-through; sealing it is what makes the store one component. The SEAFOOD title at (1005.8,208.3) is printed SE of the counter line, on the customer floor, so it stays out of this poly

Bakery/Deli east back-of-house production block (staff only): ~88x300 pt of floor between the east exterior wall (x=1195.6) and the continuous chevron of service counters that fences it off from the sales floor — [1109,356,1118,388], the wall stub x=1116 (y=388..402), [1107.5,402,1120,463], [1109,463.6,1132.5,474.9], the rotated bar with corners (1139,467)-(1169,499)-(1163,506)-(1132,475), [1162,506.9,1173.4,540.7], the rotated bar (1154,548)-(1118,584) and [1097.3,579.6,1119.3,590.6] — capped on the north by the counter run [1119,344,1183,355] plus its cross-shaped end cap [1107,344,1117,354]. The block holds no fixture, no display table and no product label; the only things printed in it are the red BAKERY (1157.9,419.1) and DELI (1139.8,541.6) department titles, which is why both fired VERIFY at 100%/94% walkable. Customers are served from the counters' west/south faces, which stay open. The 7 pt break in the chevron at y=541..548 is the staff pass-through between the deli and bakery cases

Sushiya sushi-bar work side and the staff passage that links it to the Deli/Bakery back block (staff only): the bar is the horseshoe counter [1021.4,578.6,1083.6,620] whose U opens EAST, so the pocket its legs enclose (x=1035.7..1083.6, y=588.9..609.3) is where the sushi chef stands — customers are served from outside the U, exactly as at store 24. East of the U's mouth the pocket continues as a 32 pt passage boxed in by the deli counter's last piece [1097.3,579.6,1119.3,590.6] and the rotated bar (1154,548)-(1118,584) on the north, the Texas Backyard block [1057,609.3,1131,639] on the south and the excluded back block on the east; its only link to the sales floor is the 13 pt staff gap at x=1083.6..1096.8, y~578. No fixture, badge or product label is drawn in any of it — the SUSHIYA logo is artwork printed on the counter itself. The pipeline already condemned this as an unreachable pocket (392 cells at (1086,597)); the exclusion states the reason so it does not depend on the dead-crevice size cap

Centre-entrance restrooms, RIGHT-HAND room interior (enclosed room, not sales floor): the front-wall block bounded by the drawn walls (906,611.7)-(946.6,611.7) on the north, (946.6,611.7)-(946.6,640.6) on the east, the front wall y=640.2 on the south and the stepped west wall (909.2,611.7)-(909.2,623.7)-(906,623.7)-(906,640.5). It is drawn CLOSED on all four sides — no door, no gap — and holds nothing but its restroom pictogram [919.8,621.7,943.4,637.8]: no fixture, no badge, no product label. Its twin next door ([844.2,611.8,894.8,640.4], same block, same pictogram) and both west-entrance restrooms ([366.2,607.4,488.5,639.5], [501.6,607.3,553.9,639.8]) all seal correctly as enclosed rooms; this one did not. The reason is the 3.2 pt jog segment (906,623.7)-(909.2,623.7) in its west wall: engine.build_grid samples an obstacle path at n = max(2, int(len/cell)*2) points, so at the 2 pt cell a 3.2 pt segment gets exactly 2 samples — its two endpoints — and the cell between them (x=906..908, y=622..624) is never marked. That single-cell hole let the entrance flood 153 cells (5.8 m^2) of restroom interior, bbox [906,612,944,638]; it is the ONLY region in store 227 that a dense re-raster of every wall would close, so this rect is the whole of the fix. The 11 pt restroom entry alcove west of the room (x=894.8..906, between the two pictogram rooms) is customer space and is deliberately left out
